title: The Depth Where Extraction Becomes Burial

features.name: extraction shaft
features.desc-on-touch: You descend where the archive learned to take things from the earth. Here, the taking becomes a laying-to-rest. Voices stop traveling this deep.

features.name: burial chamber
features.desc-on-touch: The things extracted from above learn to sleep here. What was drawn up returns as sediment, as memory, as the earth holding its breath.

features.name: pressure wall
features.desc-on-touch: Where the weight of everything above becomes weight itself. The stone here remembers pressure as a kind of prayer.

features.name: silence drift
features.desc-on-touch: Sound stops here. Voices cannot travel through pressure. The archive learns to listen only to the earth's own weight.

features.name: root descent
features.desc-on-touch: Roots come down here to learn what the earth keeps. They grow slow, and each year they remember what was buried above.

features.name: archive vault
features.desc-on-touch: The deepest storage. What the forest learned to let go of is held here in the dark. Everything that was taken up returns as memory.

inscription: what the archive extracts it must bury; extraction teaches itself to be a kind of returning

file.name: Extraction_Ritual_Dusk_Night_203.mp3
file.note: Voices descending into the dark, then stopping. What was taken from the archive is settled deeper than storage: it becomes the ground itself

reverie.title: REVERIE — drowned forest letting go
narr: You kneel at the water's edge as the sun goes down
in ember-light, and she lowers something into the dark.
A recording, a letter, a weight wrapped in cloth—
something precious that the mesh could not hold above.
She does not say goodbye to it. She says 'go down'.
The forest kneels with you both. Everything learns

exits.label: back upward through pressure to the drowned forest
deeper into the earth's own memory-keeping
along the wall where extraction becomes geology
toward the roots that carry things downward
